description: This script is a test script for Git, verifying merge behavior after a failed octopus merge strategy, including setup of branches, commits, and merge assertions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and base/reference.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if a command returns the expected exit code.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Asserts that a given file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of testing suite.
